answer: Unique-Material Challenge Response.** Each agent identity must answer a fresh challenge by producing a physical artifact whose microscopic material signature is measured at issue time. An operator can copy a key but cannot forge the random grain structure of the issued medium, so duplication fails at the sensor. Enrollment cost is one fabricated token per identity, and the ridge pattern is checked against a continuously updated reference to catch replayed twins. An attacker reaching for scale hits a nadir: every extra identity demands a new physical specimen and a new measurement pass,
